col_title: Breakfast | Garnì della Locanda, Dimaro Folgarida
col_desc: Breakfast at Garnì della Locanda: a warm wood-panelled room, croissants and pastries at the counter to start your day in Val di Sole.
col_sub: A warm wood-panelled room, croissants and pastries at the counter: the right way to start a day in Val di Sole.
col_p1: Breakfast is served in our room with wooden walls and warm lights, a cosy space to start the day at your own pace.
col_p2: At the counter you will find croissants and pastries, to set off full of energy for the slopes, trails or cycle paths of the valley. Half board is also available if you prefer.

bar_title: Bottega Moderna, bar in Dimaro Folgarida open to everyone | Garnì della Locanda
bar_desc: Bottega Moderna, the bar of Garnì della Locanda at Piazza Centrale 11 in Dimaro Folgarida: open to everyone, every day from 9:30 am to 1:30 pm and from 5 pm to 10 pm.
bar_sub: Our bar on Piazza Centrale in Dimaro, open to everyone: every day from 9:30 to 13:30 and from 17:00 to 22:00.
bar_p1: Bottega Moderna is the garnì's bar and is open every day to the public as well, not only to guests staying in our rooms.
bar_p2: Stop by for a morning coffee, a break after the slopes or trails, or a drink in the evening, in the centre of Dimaro Folgarida.
